thesis: Force of Nature is a lesson in early Magic's valuation of size: an enormous trampler arrived cheaply, but demanded green mana every upkeep and punished a controller who could not sustain it.

playbook.role: Build around reliable green production and use the card only when the shortened clock outweighs the upkeep risk. Trample makes pump and removal on blockers especially valuable.

counterplay.directAnswers: Attack the mana base, remove or bounce it before upkeep, or survive long enough that the upkeep becomes its own burn spell. Chump blocking alone is rarely sufficient because of trample.
